Role changes update Profile.role but leave User.is_staff and User.is_superuser unchanged. Demoting an active administrator with these flags, including the seeded administrator, leaves full access through /django-admin/. The demoted user can access all registered CRM models and restore their platform_admin profile.

Customer-controlled escalation titles are written directly into exported CSV cells. Organization names and risk notes in the other export branches are likewise unsanitized.
